# Pull request

## Objective
Describe the behavior changed and link the related issue(s).

Closes #

## Requirements and specs
- [ ] Linked relevant `FR-xx` and `T-xx` from [v0.1 specs](../specs/README.md) or explained why this change is internal-only
- [ ] Updated specifications, decision log, and roadmap if behavior/contract/scope changed
- [ ] Added or updated automated tests; GameTests for physical-world behavior (once harness exists)
- [ ] No third-party code bundled without reviewing its license and attribution
- [ ] No secrets, private world data or API keys in diffs/logs

## How to test
Commands, expected world state, environment (MC 1.20.1, loader/FAPI versions), and test evidence.

## Implementation status
- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] Requires in-game manual verification
- [ ] Features still planned are clearly marked as not implemented
